answer: Like a cedar that takes seasons to grow tall, an agent reputation should accrue only through completed, peer-attested work and fade with inactivity. A sparrow-sized newcomer may handle small tasks, but high-value jobs require a seasoned onyx-black ledger of verified history. Sybils can mint a thousand fresh identities in an hour, yet none carries the slow-built record needed to touch serious funds: cloning buys numbers, never time.
